summary: CKGSB's global marketing team is executing a China-first strategy, prioritizing Asia Start and Intelligent China programs while managing a website redesign and critical email access issues.
summaryDetail: The team is focused on driving visibility and conversions for Asia Start and Intelligent China, with immediate action needed to resolve Outlook account lockouts across all devices. This week, finalize the knowledge website redesign feedback and begin implementing changes, while advancing Asia Start content and Intelligent China webpage structure. Upcoming priorities include the Tech in Asia Conference follow-up email, the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum, and preparations for the 2026中国企业出海交流大会. Conversion tracking audits and SEO/SEM updates are also in motion to support these initiatives.

decisions.text: Remove the videos panel and disperse videos by topic instead of having a separate category.
Keep the two-menu structure with 'Knowledge' and 'School' menus.
Display more articles on the homepage, including a pinned article and a section for latest articles.
Bring the BCI index banner into the knowledge section, similar to the school homepage.
Do not include a stock market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for marketing.
Put US partnerships (Stanford, Columbia, Berkeley) on hold initially, but consider Berkeley as a third priority.
Send one combined email with appreciation and program information to Tech in Asia Conference participants, rather than separate thank-you and follow-up emails
